about_the_game:
Support DeadEagle with the Supporters Edition DLC

Thank you for considering the Supporters Edition DLC for Parcel Frenzy: Get To Work!
By purchasing this DLC, you're directly supporting the continued development efforts of DeadEagle, the solo developer behind Spitfire-Games. Your support goes directly towards the creation of new games & franchises.

Thank you for being a part of my journey.

What's Included:

Get access to a darker part of the warehouse, the boss has some secrets he doesnt want others to know about, can you help him out with that?

Each day, you’ll receive stacks of cash that need “cleaning.” Wash them, pack them neatly into a box, and send them up the giant pipe to the surface. From there, ship the goods out for a tidy profit. The boss insists it’s just prop money for movies… but why is it hidden in this dark corner? No one really knows.

content_descriptors.notes: This DLC contains a light-hearted, fictional “money cleaning” mini-game set in a hidden basement area of the warehouse. The activity is portrayed in a cartoonish, comedic way with no real criminal instruction or realistic depictions. There is no violence, drugs, or other mature content.
